blocks.text: 16. The Last City of Many Forms
Status: Established Era Three location, possibly several places merged in memory.

Origin: A late gathering place built where overlapping maintenance systems can support many body forms, healing practices, Path schools, markets, Old Sound halls, and archives. Its remembered unity may be historical, symbolic, or both.
Early Era Three: Distinct Nests and Path societies use different bodies, words, foods, and routes.
The Dimming: Rare forms, responsive ruins, and long routes disappear. Communities migrate toward surviving maintenance.
The Last Great Migration: Travelers bring incompatible measures, fragments of Old Sound, local Maker myths, and different Path traditions.

City period: Districts are shaped for different bodies. Markets and healing sites mediate difference. Some accounts describe one city; others appear to join several refuge sites into a single remembered destination.
Late Era Three: The city faces Last Loops, sleeping archives, and the dormant External Gate. Its exact fate at first player contact remains open.
Present condition: Canonically important but not fully fixed. Preserve the possibility that “the City” is a composite memory.
Corruption: 4 — many districts and perhaps many sites cobbled into one civic image.

Visual brief: A terraced city with routes for crawling, flying, swimming, climbing, rolling, and walking bodies. Door sizes conflict by district. Old maintenance ribs support market canopies. An Old Sound hall is built around a chord fragment too large for local speech. Archive towers dim at different rates. The city should feel lived-in, patched, and precious rather than monumental ruins alone.
Background traits: Neutral; variable humidity; civic/ruin biome; crowded, resilient, elegiac mood; variable friction by district.
